participation.context: Named the receipt, and refused a second twopence.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Boiled it on the Monday copper, and restated the threepence.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Counted a hundred stirs, and left the new ink downstairs.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

relations.quote: I boil it on Mondays from your receipt.
I stirred to a hundred, as you said.

story.body: You confirmed the receipt and did not change it. Alse had stirred the galls, the copperas and the gum. The Saturday horn stays on the desk at the twopence already paid. You did not sit down to the threepence, and you did not carry the new boil upstairs.

relations.quote: I boil it on Mondays from your receipt.
I stirred to a hundred, as you said.

title: Stood out of the steam while the ink boiled
